task_objective: Empirically profile and optimize Decky Loader Rust backend, installer, Steam Beta CDP scope resolution, static asset serving, and frontend boot/store performance on branch perf/loader-startup-and-memory using strict Red-Green-Refactor TDD and A/B verification on steamdeck-vm.
commits: 6bde376 perf(startup): add release LTO, cap Tokio threads, and skip worker --describe when flags provided
03d1702 perf(workers): poll pidfd before launcher status IPC and skip no-op non-root chmods
f967df5 perf(io): stream plugin ZIPs to disk, offload ZIP/filepicker I/O, and reuse HTTP clients
659a04c perf(transport,cef): optimize Beta CDP scope lookup and static asset serving
ea72222 perf(frontend): cut boot waterfall, deduplicate store/version RPCs, lazy-load store images, and speed up sorting
tests_added: tests/runtime/test_user_service_installer.py: generated unit passes --sdk-version and --python-version when manifest metadata is present
tests/frontend/store_sources.test.mts: sortStorePlugins orders by name, dates, and downloads without mutating input
tests/frontend/store_sources.test.mts: createUpdateCheckDeduplicator coalesces in-flight checks and caches only complete results
design_decisions: Passed --sdk-version and --python-version from install.py systemd unit generation with automatic fallback to DeckyPluginWorker --describe when flags are omitted (because bundle.json is not copied into installed runtime directories).

Used ownProperties: true on CDP Runtime.getProperties for function objects (empirically verified 40/40 [[Scopes]] hit rate and -84% payload size on Steam Beta 1795048523) and rejected accessorPropertiesOnly: true (0/40 scopes).
Made Runtime.releaseObjectGroup fire-and-forget via ScopeConnection::notify instead of awaiting a fifth CDP round trip per module.
Preserved transport.rs socket_lifecycle mutex for connection takeover and FULL_SYNC serialization.
Replaced SuspensefulImage in PluginCard.tsx with native plus a spinner/error overlay because @decky/ui SuspensefulImage eagerly triggers new Image() inside useEffect for every mounted card.
Kept all frontend edits strictly within existing SDK_OVERLAYS entries in scripts/runtime/prepare_bundle.py.
